reasoning_content:
The outer loop is missing an invariant stating that no valid pair exists among indices checked so far, which is why I can't derive a contradiction at loop exit or prove the postcondition at return. I'll classify this as an invariant/bridge issue and need to add that invariant to the outer loop, considering whether the inner loop also needs one.

Since the inner loop only havocs j, Dafny preserves facts about i and nums across it, so the outer invariant should combine cleanly with the inner loop's results when transitioning to i+1, giving a sound contradiction with the precondition at exit.
